prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Friend", "Select a personality archetype to bring your desktop to life.", "Select Pet Archetype"]
2: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Learn how to summon, move, and hide your pet directly from your desktop system tray.", "Got It!"]
3: ["Upload & Preview Your Pet", "Upload a photo and preview how your pet will appear on your desktop.", "Select Photo", "Check preview before confirming adoption."]
4: ["Sign in to back up your pet. Using the same account preserves your pet data.", "Cloud Save Active"]
5: ["Spawning Your Pet on Desktop...", "We are loading assets and configuring system tray desktop permissions.", "Tip: Look for the pet icon in your taskbar system tray."]
6: ["Choose Your Pet's Path", "Select a path to unlock exclusive starter accessories and animations!", "Explore Paths"]
7: ["Your Pet is Live!", "Find your pet on the desktop or click the system tray icon to open options.", "Press Ctrl+Alt+P anytime to hide or show your desktop pet.", "Start Playing"]
8: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Adopt an interactive pet that lives right on your computer screen."]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Name your pet to complete the adoption process!", "Pet Name", "Official Companion"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or exclusive gifts to incentivize selection.
